segments.contextAfter: `useAuxiliaryFile`: If [`true`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/Swift/true), the receiver is written to an auxiliary file, and then the auxiliary file is renamed to `path`. If [`false`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/Swift/false), the receiver is written directly to `path`. The [`true`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/Swift/true) option guarantees that `path`, if it exists at all, won’t be corrupted even if the system should crash during writing.
